A Native Scrobbler for Windows 11


Fluent Scrobbler — v1.1.1 Release Notes (2026-10-05)
This patch resolves metadata corruption issues during Winamp scrobbling, introduces manual instance dismissal to resolve playback conflicts, and includes general stability enhancements.
New Features
- Dismiss Detected Instances: Added an option to dismiss unwanted or conflicting detected player instances directly from the interface, preventing erroneous playback tracking.
Bugs Fixeds
- Winamp Scrolling Title Scrobble Errors: Fixed an issue where enabling Winamp's "scrolling text" title bar option resulted in corrupted, shifting track metadata being submitted to Last.fm. #5
- General Stability & Minor Fixes: Applied under-the-hood stability improvements and minor bug fixes across background session handling.
Bug Reports & Support
Despite our best efforts to ensure a polished release, bugs may occasionally occur. If you encounter any issues, please open a bug report here
Enjoying Fluent Scrobbler?
Consider supporting the project on Buy Me a Coffe to help fund future improvements. You can also help us grow by leaving a review on the store or sharing the application with friends!
